entities.title: The engine's own sine and cosine
entities.summary: Peel arcs and weaving use dsin and dcos, built from + − × ÷, never Math.sin or Math.cos.
entities.context: The server replays every submitted game and must reach exactly the positions the player saw. Math.sin and Math.cos are not promised to agree bit for bit between JavaScript engines; IEEE + − × ÷ are.

options.title: Math.sin and Math.cos
options.consequences: Simple, but a browser and the server may disagree in the last bit, and a replay drift apart.

options.title: A polynomial of plain arithmetic
options.consequences: Exact everywhere; good to about 1e-7 after reducing the angle to [−π/2, π/2].

entities.decision: trig.ts reduces the angle with Math.round and a multiple of 2π, folds it into [−π/2, π/2], and evaluates a nested Taylor series to the x¹¹ term; dcos(x) is dsin(x + π/2).
entities.rationale: The same arithmetic in every engine gives the same game in every browser and on the server.

entities.title: Pausing is a recorded input
entities.summary: A pause, even one the page makes when the tab is hidden, reaches the engine as an input on a frame and is recorded with the rest.
entities.context: A paused frame changes nothing, but the replay must know which frames were paused, or it would play them.
entities.decision: Input carries a pause press; step() toggles Game.paused on it outside the title screen and changes nothing else while paused. The page queues a pause press when the tab is hidden (Controls.queuePause) instead of stopping the loop.
entities.rationale: The recording, and so the server's replay, sees the pause on the frame it happened.
